example.body: HISTORY OF FLIGHT On January 11, 2013, about 1553 central standard time, N36VE, a Raytheon Aircraft Company 58, multi-engine airplane, was destroyed after impacting terrain near Maxwell, Nebraska. The pilot and three passengers were fatally injured. The airplane was registered to and operated by Bottorff Construction, Inc.; Atchison, Kansas. example.body: At 1553 a "mayday" call was heard and a simultaneous loss of radio and radar contact was reported by the radar controller.
